notes:
- Account: large regional grid operator; substations + central NOC. Sensitive PII & operational telemetry.
- Primary ask: air-gapped private deployment (no outbound telemetry), signed model images delivered on encrypted media.
- Security: must support HSM-backed keys, FIPS-validated crypto, integration with existing Thales HSM, strict audit logs, >7 year retention for selected logs.
- Model lifecycle: offline model image updates via signed artifacts, image verification, and offline rollout procedure. No automatic internet pulls.
- Runtime constraints: deterministic performance targets; 95th pct latency target for short-chat flows <= 120ms token-step in peak, throughput ~200 req/s for incident triage workload.
- Quality bar: small hallucination budget; want deterministic reranking and strict provenance for any training-derived outputs.
- Ops: need playbook for cache invalidation across air-gapped clusters, KV cache snapshot/restore process, and canary process that works without external control plane.
- Quote from security lead: "We cannot accept outbound telemetry unless anonymized + reviewable + disabled by default."
- Price sensitivity: medium-high; prefer fixed-cost Private license + optional Optimize consultancy.
- POC so far: baseline private bundle deployed in lab; passed smoke tests, latency borderline at peak. Waiting on HSM cert and network topology sign-off.
- Docs shared: security matrix, network diagram template, deployment checklist.
- Next: onsite security workshop (3/18) to validate HSM integration plan, air-gap delivery logistics, and finalize procurement SOW.
